## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
CAUTION: Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; signs conflicting — strong sector breadth but narrow leadership and major mega-cap divergences; defensive names are not leading. Confirmations: 1) 8/11 sectors positive; 2) Top 5 leaders concentrated in Technology (4/5) and multiple large-cap names show 1W vs 1M divergence — watch for trend breaks.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Technology lead: NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND; Tech breadth: 18/24 positive. Materials strong: NEM (1W: +20.56% | 1M: +19.16%) ABOVE TREND; Materials breadth: 9/11 positive. Industrials next: BA (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +5.07%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials breadth: 11/15 positive.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Energy lagging: EOG (1W: -9.38% | 1M: +1.65%) CORRECTION, CVX (1W: -5.22% | 1M: +7.19%) CORRECTION; Energy breadth: 2/10 positive. Utilities weak: SRE (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -11.35%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -11.01%) BELOW TREND; Utilities breadth: 3/10 positive. Real Estate soft: (real estate breadth: 4/10 positive).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +29.38% | 1M: +23.06%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +20.56% | 1M: +19.16%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +13.72% | 1M: -12.17%) RECOVERY, ORCL (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +2.30%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: EOG (1W: -9.38% | 1M: +1.65%) CORRECTION, CVS (1W: -8.36% | 1M: -6.34%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -6.25% | 1M: -6.41%) BELOW TREND, MPC (1W: -5.77% | 1M: +5.26%) CORRECTION, SRE (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -11.35%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in Energy/Utilities.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Highest 1W momentum: PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +29.38% | 1M: +23.06%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +13.72% | 1M: -12.17%) RECOVERY; note MAJOR divergence across large caps (AAPL, META, TSLA showing 1W up vs 1M down) — treat as tactical, not full confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Tech mixed but strong on the week; NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND while AAPL (1W: +1.43% | 1M: -0.91%) RECOVERY and INTC (1W: +12.69% | 1M: -9.68%) RECOVERY — Tech breadth: 18/24 positive.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials constructive but mixed internals; JPM (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND while V (1W: -0.99% | 1M: +4.11%) CORRECTION and MA (1W: -1.77% | 1M: +7.60%) CORRECTION — Financials breadth: 12/20 positive and supports selective exposure to large banks.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare quietly positive but mixed; JNJ (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +0.05%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +3.21% | 1M: -2.57%) RECOVERY — Healthcare breadth: 11/17 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor selective exposure to Technology winners (NVDA, MSFT, ORCL) and cyclicals showing real strength (NEM, FCX, CAT) while reducing exposure to names exhibiting short-term/long-term divergence (AAPL, META, TSLA). Given CAUTION regime and major divergence across mega-caps, keep allocations tactical and emphasize stocks with confirmed ABOVE TREND status.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND — watch for extension of 1W momentum.  
BEARISH: MAR (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -4.98%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -8.36% | 1M: -6.34%) BELOW TREND, EOG (1W: -9.38% | 1M: +1.65%) CORRECTION — watch for continued downside or failed bounces.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Technology (Tech breadth: 18/24 positive) and Materials (9/11 positive) for leadership continuation.  
BEARISH: Energy (2/10 positive) and Utilities (3/10 positive) for further underperformance and rotation risk.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND — confirmation on sustained break above this week’s highs would signal trend continuation. AAPL (1W: +1.43% | 1M: -0.91%) RECOVERY — failure to hold the 1W gain risks a reversion to below-trend action. JPM (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND — watch for follow-through above recent resistance to confirm Financials strength.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
LLY (+85): Eli Lilly headline on blowout growth and raised outlook; LLY (1W: +3.21% | 1M: -2.57%) RECOVERY — short-term sentiment confirming 1W move but 1M still negative (partial divergence).  
CAT (+75): Positive guidance/upgrade headlines; CAT (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.09%) RECOVERY — sentiment supports 1W bounce but 1M down suggests watch for sustainability.  
MPC (+80): Refiners earnings jump; MPC (1W: -5.77% | 1M: +5.26%) CORRECTION — bullish news contrasts with weak 1W performance, monitor for mean reversion.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
META (-45): Negative headlines on fund flows and analyst chatter; META (1W: +6.36% | 1M: -6.24%) RECOVERY — bearish news but 1W strength creates a divergence—watch for distribution.  
MAR (-45): Revenue miss headlines; MAR (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -4.98%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by price weakness.  

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, Growth/Momentum tilt.  
PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +29.38% | 1M: +23.06%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND are showing the most conviction.  
Key risk: major divergence among large caps (AAPL, META, TSLA in RECOVERY) and narrow leadership (4/5 Tech) — watch sentiment mismatches (LLY bullish vs META negative) for trend confirmation or failure.
